Standard: During maneuvering up to the AOA and AOS limits, the air vehicle does not exhibit uncommanded motions that cannot be arrested promptly by simple application of pilot control. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's uncommanded motions, if encountered, up to the AOA and AOS limits as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Uncommanded Motions paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's uncommanded motions, if encountered, up to the AOA and AOS limits as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Uncommanded Motions paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's uncommanded motions, if encountered, up to the AOA and AOS limits as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Uncommanded Motions paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
